snippet.title: Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence is a classic 90s-style point & click adventure featuring dark, detailed pixel art, environmental puzzles, and a deep narrative with touches of dark humor. Available in late 2025. Add it to your wishlist! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929410/Scholar_Adventure_Mystery_of_Silence/

Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence © 2025 Ayose Trujillo & Making Enemies · Published by: DevilishGames - Spherical Pixel S.L.
